headers.name: actual_finite_boundary_order
headers.header:
theorem actual_finite_boundary_order
    (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u≠v) :
    ∃ (C : Set Plane) (f : ℝ → Plane) (θ : (M).OpenedTip → ℝ) (xs : List (M).OpenedTip),
      IsJordanCurve C ∧
      Graph.face (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b))
        (coordinates face.outside)=outside C ∧
      IsLoop f ∧ f '' unitInterval=C ∧
      (∀ t, θ t∈Ico (0:ℝ) 1 ∧ f (θ t)=tipPoint N D b hg hb t) ∧
      Function.Injective θ ∧ xs.Nodup ∧ (∀ t, t∈xs) ∧
      xs.Pairwise (fun a c => θ a≤θ c) ∧
      (∀ (k : (M).OpenedHybridEdge) (a c d e : (M).OpenedTip),
        (OG).OrientedQuartet k ((M).openedTipVertex a) ((M).openedTipVertex c)
          ((M).openedTipVertex d) ((M).openedTipVertex e) →
        ¬((θ a<θ d ∧ θ d<θ c ∧ θ c<θ e) ∨
          (θ d<θ a ∧ θ a<θ e ∧ θ e<θ c))) ∧
      (∀ a c : (M).OpenedTip, θ a<θ c →
        (M).openedTipLabel hl a=(M).openedTipLabel hl c →
        (∀ w, ¬(θ a<θ w ∧ θ w<θ c)) ∨
          (∀ w, ¬(θ w<θ a ∨ θ c<θ w)))

headers.name: actual_named_boundary_noninterlacing
headers.header:
theorem actual_named_boundary_noninterlacing
    (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    {C : Set Schoenflies.Plane} (hC : IsJordanCurve C)
    (hface : Graph.face (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b))
      (coordinates face.outside)=outside C)
    (f : (M).OpenedHybridEdge) (a c d e : (M).OpenedTip) (hac : a≠c) (hde : d≠e)
    (hq : (OG).OrientedQuartet f ((M).openedTipVertex a) ((M).openedTipVertex c)
      ((M).openedTipVertex d) ((M).openedTipVertex e))
    (A₁ A₂ : Set Schoenflies.Plane)
    (hcut : IsCutPair C (tipPoint N D b hg hb a) (tipPoint N D b hg hb c) A₁ A₂) :
    ¬(tipPoint N D b hg hb d∈A₁ ∧ tipPoint N D b hg hb e∈A₂)

headers.name: actual_shared_boundary_receiver
headers.header:
theorem actual_shared_boundary_receiver
    (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u≠v) :
    ∃ C : Set Schoenflies.Plane, IsJordanCurve C ∧
      Graph.face (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b))
        (coordinates face.outside)=outside C ∧
      Function.Injective (tipPoint N D b hg hb) ∧
      (∀ t : (M).OpenedTip, tipPoint N D b hg hb t∈C) ∧
      (∀ (f : (M).OpenedHybridEdge) (a c d e : (M).OpenedTip), a≠c → d≠e →
        (OG).OrientedQuartet f ((M).openedTipVertex a) ((M).openedTipVertex c)
          ((M).openedTipVertex d) ((M).openedTipVertex e) →
        ∀ A₁ A₂ : Set Schoenflies.Plane,
          IsCutPair C (tipPoint N D b hg hb a) (tipPoint N D b hg hb c) A₁ A₂ →
          ¬(tipPoint N D b hg hb d∈A₁ ∧ tipPoint N D b hg hb e∈A₂)) ∧
      (∀ a c : (M).OpenedTip, a≠c → (M).openedTipLabel hl a=(M).openedTipLabel hl c →
        ∃ B : Set Schoenflies.Plane, B⊆C ∧
          IsArcBetween B (tipPoint N D b hg hb a) (tipPoint N D b hg hb c) ∧
          ∀ w : (M).OpenedTip, tipPoint N D b hg hb w∈B ↔ w=a ∨ w=c)

headers.name: finite_occurrence_parameters
headers.header:
theorem finite_occurrence_parameters {T : Type*} [Fintype T]
    {C : Set Plane} (hC : IsJordanCurve C) (point : T → Plane)
    (hinj : Function.Injective point) (hmem : ∀ t, point t∈C) :
    ∃ (f : ℝ → Plane) (θ : T → ℝ) (xs : List T),
      IsLoop f ∧ f '' unitInterval=C ∧
      (∀ t, θ t∈Ico (0:ℝ) 1 ∧ f (θ t)=point t) ∧
      Function.Injective θ ∧ xs.Nodup ∧ (∀ t, t∈xs) ∧
      xs.Pairwise (fun a c => θ a≤θ c)

headers.name: parameter_cut_pair
headers.header:
theorem parameter_cut_pair {f : ℝ → Plane} (hf : IsLoop f)
    {s t : ℝ} (hs : s∈Ico (0:ℝ) 1) (ht : t∈Ico (0:ℝ) 1) (hst : s<t) :
    IsCutPair (f '' unitInterval) (f s) (f t)
      (f '' Icc s t) (f '' Icc 0 s ∪ f '' Icc t 1)

headers.name: connected_boundary_cut_false
headers.header:
theorem connected_boundary_cut_false {C B A₁ A₂ : Set Plane} {p q x y : Plane}
    (hcut : IsCutPair C p q A₁ A₂) (hB : IsPreconnected B) (hBC : B⊆C)
    (hp : p∉B) (hq : q∉B) (hx : x∈B) (hy : y∈B)
    (hxA : x∈A₁) (hyA : y∈A₂) : False

headers.name: empty_pair_arc_parameter_gap
headers.header:
theorem empty_pair_arc_parameter_gap {T : Type*}
    {f : ℝ → Plane} (hf : IsLoop f) (θ : T → ℝ)
    (hθ : ∀ t, θ t∈Ico (0:ℝ) 1)
    {a c : T} (hac : θ a<θ c) {B : Set Plane}
    (hB : IsArcBetween B (f (θ a)) (f (θ c)))
    (hBC : B⊆f '' unitInterval)
    (honly : ∀ w, f (θ w)∈B ↔ w=a ∨ w=c) :
    (∀ w, ¬(θ a<θ w ∧ θ w<θ c)) ∨
      (∀ w, ¬(θ w<θ a ∨ θ c<θ w))
